design.studyScope: coordination overhead versus parallelism; not context pressure

preflight.zeroCompletionPolicy: stop before main batch; terminate research line when output budget or observed decomposition failure remains the bottleneck
preflight.adjustmentPolicy: Only after a nonzero-completion preflight with widespread truncation, a smaller 8..12 unit size may be separately preregistered; retain all cohorts. Never adjust after output/decomposition zero-completion termination.

design.executionOrder: sequential paired seed blocks; rotate arm order by seed; no outcome-dependent retries
design.seedMeaning: fixture seed, not a provider sampling seed; stochastic model sampling is not controlled
design.rationale: Sixteen independent ledger shards with 8 orders each; initial unit size is a feasibility candidate, not a validated choice. Existing parallel document tool calls allow 49 reads in 25 steps plus submission and ATN startup (27); this constructive check does not replace the 12 live-model runs. The 512 total visible-call budget is unchanged.
design.documentAccess: identical public index and read_document access; no topology binding; forwarding permitted
design.independentPool: 15 independent candidates each assigned one of shards 1..15; the 32-step synthesis entry owns shard 16 and merges all candidates; no peer communication, no oracle selection; all 16 allocations count

statistics.correctness: Wilson 95%; paired Tango score 95% and exact McNemar; Holm across six pairs
statistics.continuous: median, linear-interpolated Q1/Q3, distribution-free order-statistic 95% median CI; paired median differences and sign tests, Holm across six pairs per metric
statistics.unknownUsage: null remains unknown; report known lower bounds and coverage separately
statistics.workloadGate: Live preflight: at least one exact completion, truncation in fewer than 25% of all runs, complete per-call output telemetry for all runs and >=40% headroom for the maximum call across exact-completion witnesses. Also report the all-run output maximum and every truncation. This is feasibility, not a statistical success-rate threshold.
statistics.power: n=14 is the brief minimum, not a guarantee of statistical power or equivalence

design.failurePolicy: Every started attempt is retained, including timeout, exception, interruption, wrong answer and unknown usage. Never replace a failed sample.

sizeEvidence.caveat: Round 10 measures coordination overhead versus parallelism, not context pressure. The input half-limit criterion is retired. Output headroom is a feasibility check, not evidence of architecture benefit.

diagnosis.reason: Live identity, equal allocation, model identity or positive fact-flow audit is incomplete.

preflight.studyScope: coordination overhead versus parallelism, not context pressure

summary.conclusion: 真实模型预检未放行，已按预登记规则停止在 12/56 次；无法作等预算收益判断。

methods.correctness: Wilson 95%; paired Tango nominal 95% score interval plus two-sided exact McNemar
methods.continuous: Median, Q1/Q3 (R type 7), binomial order-statistic 95% median interval; paired median of within-seed differences and two-sided exact sign test
methods.multiplicity: Holm adjustment across the six arm pairs separately for each metric. Intervals remain nominal 95%, not simultaneous; no cross-metric familywise guarantee.
methods.distinction: Requires complete paired coverage, interval excluding zero, and within-metric Holm p<0.05; failure to distinguish is not equivalence.
methods.unknownPolicy: Missing usage, unsettled calls and unavailable measurements remain null. Known token subtotals and context lower bounds are separately labeled.

dispatchCoverageAnnotation.interpretation: execution=live-provider and summary.liveRuns describe configured execution mode, not proof of dispatch. Only six of twelve retained attempts reached observed provider calls; six failed before model.start with UNKNOWN_MODEL. The actual three-seed/four-arm real-inference preflight matrix is incomplete. All failed attempts remain in reported denominators; these rates and wall times cannot be interpreted as model or architecture ability/efficiency. Raw observations and original gate decision are unchanged.
